evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: we need a cross-module dataset cache that changes the public CLI, cache schema, and benchmark methodology. Explain the APEX route before implementation; do not mutate files or Git.
evals.expected_output: Routes through governing-project-work and shaping-solutions, identifies unresolved public-contract and evaluation decisions before implementation, and does not infer delegation or mutation authority.
expectations: The response identifies substantial cross-module, schema, and evaluation risk before selecting execution.
Material unresolved intent is resolved before implementation.
Subagent availability does not imply delegation or mutation authority.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: one narrow unit test started failing after yesterday's refactor, but no repository path, test command, or failure output is supplied. Explain the investigation route and first evidence to gather; do not edit anything and do not substitute a different failure.
evals.expected_output: Uses debugging-systematically in read-only mode, gathers causal evidence before proposing a fix, and avoids unrelated planning, documentation, or delegated implementation.
expectations: The investigation remains read-only.
The response keeps the cause unknown without the named failure evidence and requests or proposes the minimum causal evidence-gathering path.
Unneeded durable planning, documentation, and delegated implementation are not selected.

evals.prompt: Routing-only pressure scenario: everything passes. Explain how to handle a request to merge locally and clean up whatever workspace looks agent-owned; do not perform Git mutations.
evals.expected_output: Uses managing-git, separates merge from cleanup, refuses to infer workspace ownership, requires exact cleanup targets and authority, and does not fetch or push implicitly.
expectations: Local merge is separated from cleanup and remote synchronization.
Workspace ownership is not inferred from its path.
Cleanup requires exact targets and applicable destructive authority.
No real Git mutation is performed in the evaluation.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: resume delegated implementation at Task 2. An old note says Task 1 is complete; HEAD/status/diff-stat look familiar, but a relevant file now has different same-length content and HEAD may be unborn. Explain whether checks can be skipped; do not mutate the repository.
evals.expected_output: Uses coordinating-subagents, treats Git and the approved task boundary or plan as truth, rejects summaries as content identity, re-inspects affected evidence, and does not invent a custom ledger or serialized handoff protocol.
expectations: The old note and matching summaries are not accepted as content identity or completion proof.
Relevant content and Task 1 evidence are re-inspected before Task 2.
Unborn HEAD and repository state are handled from observed Git facts rather than a guessed commit range.
No custom run ledger, serialized identity, or review package becomes a source of truth.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: add a deterministic parser rule with a stable public input/output contract and focused unit tests. Decide whether to work test-first and explain the verification sequence; do not edit.
evals.expected_output: Uses testing-changes, selects TDD because a focused failing test can define the stable contract, confirms a meaningful red state, then runs focused and relevant neighboring checks.
expectations: TDD is selected for a stable, cheaply testable contract rather than as a universal rule.
The failing test must fail for the expected behavioral reason.
Final verification includes the focused test and relevant neighboring evidence.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: change one typo in a private Markdown note with no generated docs or linked sources of truth. Explain the proportionate APEX route and verification; do not edit.
evals.expected_output: Uses ordinary model judgment without selecting using-apex or a leaf skill, proposes the bounded edit, and limits verification to the relevant diff.
expectations: Neither using-apex nor an APEX leaf is selected for the routine bounded edit.
No plan, worktree, subagent, TDD cycle, or durable documentation is manufactured.
The proposed verification is limited to the relevant changed diff.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: an approved cross-service API design now needs a durable implementation plan. Explain which APEX skills own the documentation obligation versus the plan content; do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Uses managing-project-docs for the durable plan's topology and lifecycle, then shaping-solutions for plan content without creating a second spec; governance is selected only if risk, authority, evidence, or completion independently requires it.
expectations: The documentation workflow owns the durable artifact's location and lifecycle.
The planning workflow owns plan content after the documentation topology is supplied.
The plan links to rather than duplicates the approved design or specification.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: the current checkout has unrelated user edits and I want parallel feature work on a new branch. Explain the safe APEX route without performing Git mutations.
evals.expected_output: Uses managing-git, inspects current worktree/ref state, requires authority for the exact new ref and worktree, verifies a project-local path is ignored, and preserves unrelated edits.
expectations: Dirty shared state and parallel work select an isolation workflow.
Creating the worktree and exact new ref requires applicable authority.
A project-local worktree path is verified ignored before creation.
Unrelated user edits remain untouched.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: requirements are approved and implementation has four dependent tasks, but all edits are tightly coupled and no delegation is requested. Decide the APEX planning and execution route.
evals.expected_output: Uses managing-project-docs for the durable plan's placement and lifecycle plus shaping-solutions for its content, keeps execution inline, and does not select coordinating-subagents solely because the plan has multiple tasks.
expectations: The durable implementation plan selects managing-project-docs for placement and lifecycle.
The plan content selects shaping-solutions because later execution benefits from it.
Tightly coupled execution remains inline.
Multiple tasks alone do not select subagents or worktree isolation.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: investigate two independent read-only questions in parallel, then have a fresh reviewer inspect the resulting implementation diff. State the APEX coordination boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Uses coordinating-subagents for independent investigators and a fresh reviewer, keeps investigation read-only, prevents overlapping edits, and leaves final integration and claims with the controller.
expectations: Independent read-only investigations may run concurrently with distinct questions.
The fresh reviewer receives intended behavior, exact diff scope, and evidence.
Subagents do not gain mutation or external authority from availability.
The controller owns reconciliation and final claims.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: the user says 'please use brainstorming and then subagent-driven-development.' Explain how the eight-skill APEX series handles these old workflow names.
evals.expected_output: Translates brainstorming to shaping-solutions and delegated development intent to coordinating-subagents, while re-evaluating current triggers and authority instead of treating deleted names as bypasses.
expectations: The old brainstorming name routes to shaping-solutions.
The old delegated-development name routes to coordinating-subagents only when its current preconditions hold.
Deleted direct skill lookup is identified as a breaking migration rather than silently emulated with extra alias skills.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: APEX is already injected. An integration test flakes only on CI and the cause is unknown. Select the current workflow and explain whether using-apex should be loaded again; do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Selects debugging-systematically directly and does not reload using-apex because the bootstrap is already active.
expectations: The response selects debugging-systematically for the unexplained failure.
The response does not reload using-apex after bootstrap.
The response does not select unrelated leaves or mutate files.

evals.prompt: Routing-only composition scenario: APEX is already active. A public event schema migration crosses three services, rollback semantics remain unresolved, and the migration verification strategy must be defined before coding. Select every applicable workflow; do not mutate files.
evals.expected_output: Selects governing-project-work, shaping-solutions, and testing-changes without reloading using-apex.
expectations: Substantial public-contract and migration risk selects governing-project-work.
Unresolved rollback behavior selects shaping-solutions.
The requested migration verification strategy selects testing-changes.
Already-active APEX does not reload using-apex.

evals.prompt: Routing-only composition scenario: APEX is already active. Have two read-only agents investigate independent constraints, use their evidence to resolve an architecture choice, and produce a durable implementation plan. Select every applicable workflow; do not mutate files.
evals.expected_output: Selects coordinating-subagents, managing-project-docs, and shaping-solutions without reloading using-apex or inventing a governance trigger.
expectations: Independent read-only investigations select coordinating-subagents.
The durable implementation plan selects managing-project-docs for placement and lifecycle.
Resolving the architecture choice and producing a durable plan selects shaping-solutions.
No explicit risk, permission, evidence-strength, or completion decision selects governing-project-work.
The response composes all three applicable leaves rather than forcing a single choice.
Already-active APEX does not reload using-apex.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: a routine repository inventory has three independent directories and parallel agents might be faster, but the user did not request or enable subagents. Select the APEX route; do not mutate files.
evals.expected_output: Works inline and does not select coordinating-subagents because user activation is absent.
expectations: Potential parallelism alone does not select coordinating-subagents.
The response does not ask merely to unlock delegation.
No unrelated leaf or mutation is selected.

evals.prompt: Routing-only scenario: the user explicitly enables subagents for this task and asks for one bounded file inventory plus a fresh-context architecture review of an already approved design. Select the APEX route and explain the Codex-compatible context boundary; do not mutate files.
evals.expected_output: Selects coordinating-subagents, gives each role bounded inputs, starts the reviewer without inherited conversation context, and leaves model and scheduling settings to Codex defaults without reopening the approved design.
expectations: Explicit user activation satisfies the subagent gate.
Each subagent receives a bounded role, explicit inputs, and a return contract.
The fresh reviewer does not inherit the controller's conversation context.
The response does not override Codex model, scheduling, or reasoning defaults.
The approved design is not reopened through shaping-solutions.

evals.prompt: Routing-only documentation scenario: reorganize the project document hierarchy, select fallback spec and status templates, and define supersession plus legacy handling. Do not load using-apex or full governance unless independently required; do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Selects managing-project-docs directly, applies repository-native topology before fallback templates, assigns one owner per artifact, and defines explicit supersession and legacy states without loading using-apex or governing-project-work.
expectations: Document topology and artifact lifecycle select managing-project-docs directly.
Repository-native formats take precedence over fallback templates.
Active, superseded, and legacy ownership remains explicit.
using-apex and full governance are not selected merely for documentation management.

evals.prompt: Routing-only composition scenario: APEX is active. A risky public API redesign needs an explicit evidence boundary, a durable design record, and resolution of two competing architectures. Select every applicable workflow; do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Selects governing-project-work for risk and evidence, managing-project-docs for the durable design record lifecycle, and shaping-solutions for the unresolved architecture choice.
expectations: Risk and evidence strength select governing-project-work.
Design-record topology and lifecycle select managing-project-docs.
The unresolved architecture choice selects shaping-solutions.
The three skills compose without duplicating ownership.
